title: Launch a coin that plants real trees
blurb: Launch a coin. 100% of its creator fees plant real trees.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Every trade plants a tree.

Launch a coin on Treepad and 100% of its creator fees buy real trees.

Set it up

Pick a name, a ticker and an image. Sign with your wallet. Your coin goes live on pump.fun with the tree split locked on chain.

Traders pay nothing extra. The trees come from the normal creator fee every coin already charges.

Your coin grows a tree

Every coin gets its own pixel tree. It grows with the market cap. A seed at launch, a sapling at $50k, a giant at $1M.

See every tree

Tree-Nation puts them in the ground. Right now that’s Grey Mangroves at Kenya Mangroves Restoration.

Every tree gets a public certificate, and every fee claim is a Solana transaction. Open any of it on the site.

Your coin. Real trees.

Launch one on treepad.fun

What would you name yours? Tell me below.
